faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Does Jawab24 support WhatsApp and Instagram?
faq.a1: Yes. Jawab24 answers on Facebook Pages and linked Instagram Business accounts on all plans, and on WhatsApp Business numbers on the Business plan and up — all from one shared inbox.
faq.a2: Check our pricing page for current rates - we have plans for every business size.
faq.q3: How does the system ensure accuracy?
faq.a3: Through the "Business Info" you add, the AI sticks to the information you provide to ensure no wrong answers are given.
faq.q4: Can I upgrade or change my plan later?
faq.a4: Absolutely! You can upgrade or change your plan anytime from the dashboard. Changes apply immediately.
faq.q5: Does Jawab24 integrate with Shopify, Salla, and Zid?
faq.a5: Yes! Connect your Shopify, Salla, or Zid store and Jawab24 will understand your products so it can answer customer questions accurately based on what you actually sell.
